items.title: Confirm and extract the two inputs: REVIEW round count and per-round blocking-finding counts
items.context: Round count is already derived from story events (how many times the story entered REVIEW) in core/guard-utils.ts / core/machine.ts; the DONE summary 'REVIEW: entered N times' uses it. Findings carry reviewRound and core/review-escalation.ts already groups findings by round and computes firstReviewRound. Produce a thin read-only accessor that returns { roundCount, perRoundBlockingCounts } for a story without duplicating existing logic.
items.userSees: A helper returns the current story's REVIEW round count and an ordered array of blocking-finding counts per round, sourced from existing event/finding data (verified by a smoke printing e.g. roundCount=3 perRound=[2,1,0]).

happy.desc: Accessor returns the REVIEW round count (via resolveReviewRoundCount) and an ordered per-round blocking-finding count array for a real story

edge.desc: A story with a single round / no findings yields roundCount=1 and a per-round array with no spurious entries

adversarial.desc: Per-round blocking counts are derived via isFindingBlocking/effectiveBlockingSeverities and resolveReviewRoundCount is reused — no duplicated round-count or blocking logic

verificationEvidence.note: collectReviewConvergenceInputs returns roundCount (via resolveReviewRoundCount) + dense round-aligned perRoundBlockingCounts; verified by smoke + inline asserts
Single-round / no-finding story yields roundCount=1 and zero-filled per-round counts, no spurious entries
Reuses isFindingBlocking/resolveReviewRoundCount; dense round-aligned so decay tier keys on actual round number (inline assert [1,1,0,0] with empty round 3 proves no index shift)

items.title: Implement core/review-convergence.ts pure function plus threshold constants and the advisory message builder
items.context: Pure function assessReviewConvergence(roundCount, perRoundBlockingCounts) returning { stalled, message? }. Trend-based heuristic (NOT a raw round ceiling): stalled = roundCount >= STALL_MIN_ROUNDS (e.g. 4) AND the last STALL_WINDOW (e.g. 3) rounds show no downward trend in blocking counts (still surfacing new blockers, not trending toward 0). No I/O. Thresholds are module constants, no CLI/config (YAGNI). Message is English-only and includes the escalation suggestion (Debugging Contract escalation plus a dismiss-don't-re-round hint).
items.userSees: assessReviewConvergence returns stalled=false for a healthy decreasing series like [2,1,0] and stalled=true with an English advisory for a flat/rising series like [2,2,1] at round 4.

happy.desc: assessReviewConvergence returns stalled=true with an English advisory for a flat/rising series like [2,2,1] at round >= STALL_MIN_ROUNDS

edge.desc: Returns stalled=false when roundCount is below STALL_MIN_ROUNDS regardless of counts

adversarial.desc: Returns stalled=false for a healthy decreasing series like [2,1,0] — no false alarm on convergence

verificationEvidence.note: assessReviewConvergence returns stalled=true with English message for [2,2,1] at round>=4 (smoke case a)
Returns stalled=false when roundCount < STALL_MIN_ROUNDS (smoke case c, 3<4)
Returns stalled=false for healthy decreasing [2,1,0] and clean-tail series (smoke case b) - no false alarm

items.title: Wire the advisory into the story_advance REVIEW output and add a smoke covering four cases; assert it never blocks
items.context: Inject the advisory into the REVIEW-entry output in handlers/transition-effects.ts (the place that prints 'Active reviewers' / 'launch in parallel'). Optionally also surface one line in session_brief REVIEW rendering. Add a smoke (packages/main/src/tasks style) covering: (a) healthy decreasing -> no advisory, (b) stalled flat/rising -> advisory, (c) below STALL_MIN_ROUNDS -> no advisory, (d) single clean round -> no advisory; AND assert that when the advisory is present, REVIEW->TEST still succeeds (advisory-only, never a gate). Wire the smoke into the validate/test chain.
items.userSees: Re-entering REVIEW on a stalled story prints the English convergence-stall advisory; lattice validate stays green with the smoke; a story showing the advisory can still advance REVIEW->TEST (proving it does not block).

happy.desc: Re-entering REVIEW on a stalled story prints the English convergence-stall advisory in the story_advance output

edge.desc: No advisory is printed for a healthy/below-threshold story (no noise)

adversarial.desc: With the advisory present, REVIEW->TEST still succeeds — the advisory never blocks a transition
